hv_sched_p: The reward halves at every halving. Each bar is the daily base reward, drawn to scale.
hv_blk_note: Block reward is calculated at 1,800 blocks per epoch.
hv_what_p: A halving cuts the rate at which new CKB is issued to miners. The block reward drops by half on a fixed schedule.
hv_why_p: It makes issuance predictable. New supply follows a decaying curve instead of an open-ended one, which is one of the main differences from fiat money.
hv_how2_p: Base issuance rewards miners and halves about every 4 years, until all 33.6 billion base-issuance CKB is mined. Time is counted in epochs of about 4 hours, so every halving lands on a fixed epoch number.
hv_infl_n: It keeps falling toward 0% with every halving.
hv_rew_h: A block reward has four parts
hv_rew_p: The schedule above covers the base issuance only.

sb_desc: How to add a project to CKBdapps: one small file and a pull request on GitHub.
sb_p: Every project on CKBdapps is one small text file in our GitHub repository. Add yours with a pull request: after a short review it goes live with the next deploy.
sb_s1_p: The button opens GitHub with the file already filled in. If you cannot write to the repository, GitHub first copies it to your account (a fork); that is expected.
sb_s2_h: Name it and fill it in
sb_s2_p: Rename the file after your project, in lowercase letters, digits and dashes, such as my-wallet.md. Then replace the example values:
sb_f_name: name: the project name, written the way you write it.
sb_f_url: url: the website, or the repository if there is no website.
sb_f_tagline: tagline: one sentence. For both languages, write en: and zh: on two indented lines below it.
sb_f_cats: categories: one or more ids from the list below.
sb_s3_p: Choose “Commit changes”, then “Create pull request”. Checks run automatically and a maintainer reviews it. If something is flagged, fix it in the same pull request.
sb_o_links: links: x and telegram as handles, discord and docs as URLs.
sb_o_github: github: owner/repo: shows the project's public GitHub activity on its page.
sb_o_community: community: true: built and run by an individual or a small independent team, not by a foundation or one of its affiliates, and not by a company with outside investment. Maintainers check this in review.
sb_o_about: Text after the second --- becomes the About section, in Markdown.
sb_o_logo: A logo: a square WebP of at most 256 px, added as public/logos/your-file-name.webp in the same pull request. Without one, the page shows a generated pattern.
sb_update: Already listed? Open the project's page and use “Edit on GitHub” to update it.
